title: Broken Calculator
summary: Given a starting integer and a target, determine the least number of operations required to reach the target using only multiplication by two or subtraction by one.
statement: Given a starting integer and a target, determine the least number of operations required to reach the target using only multiplication by two or subtraction by one.
constraints: Starting from startValue, either double the display or subtract one.
Return the minimum operations to reach target.
hints: Reverse the operations: an even target can be halved; an odd target must first be incremented.
Work backward while target exceeds startValue.
Even: target//=2; odd: target+=1; finally add startValue-target decrements.
These forced reverse choices dominate forward search and reduce the target exponentially.
editorial: These forced reverse choices dominate forward search and reduce the target exponentially.

tests.explanation: Double 2 to 4, then subtract one: two operations.
Subtract to 4, then double to 8: two operations.
